rows.liveDbObject: (missing) — Supabase Auth error code + client state; dormant/withdrawn maps to profiles.status (blocked/deleted)
rows.rationale: Error reasons are client state mapped from Supabase Auth error codes (mapSupabaseErrorCode per functional-spec line 51). description.md line 52: lockout enforced server-side by Supabase rate-limit; client failure counter is a UX hint, NOT a security device → no client-side persistence/column. screen-data-summary.md 메모 line 34 'Auth 오류 reason은 클라이언트 상태로 처리한다'. Dormant/withdrawn account messaging reuses profiles.status (active/blocked/deleted). No DB error-store column needed; no stable-query need (counter is non-authoritative UX).

rows.liveDbObject: (missing) — no auth-attempt/login-ledger table in LIVE schema
rows.rationale: CONTRACT-NOT-LABEL + STABLE-QUERY analysis: this is a hypothetical future feature ('필요하면', conditional). description.md (PRIMARY) explicitly states the client failure counter is a UX hint and lockout is enforced by Supabase server-side rate-limit, NOT a client/DB security device — so the current login screen has NO confirmed query/validation/render need for a login ledger. study_events exists but its event_type catalog is frozen separately and contains no login/auth-attempt event. A genuine security-audit ledger is net-new scope → route to UNRESOLVED (escalate, do not propose/apply a migration). NOT a schema-gap for THIS screen because no confirmed screen requirement depends on it.
